title: THE VISITORS WHO CAME AS WEATHER
deck: A delegation whose bodies are weather fronts has crossed the sealed homes of Aster Vale because it cannot imagine an outside, leaving two children struggling to breathe. With dispersal aircraft launching in three hours, Illuminara must discover a boundary the visitors can perceive and the settlers can control—without asking either side to enter a room that cannot let them leave.
shape: Five scenes move from a clinic invaded by living fog to a first exchange in pressure and rain, then to a decommissioned crop chamber rebuilt with two independently controlled membranes. A small unmanned test exposes a rival cause—heat, not language alone, drives the incursions—and forces both sides to revise the design. Settlers and visitors finally choose a breathable corridor that stops the crossings, protects the children and preserves contact, while the injuries, a ruined greenhouse and the visitors' refused demand for unrestricted passage remain real.

scenes.title: Weather Inside the Nursery
paragraphs: *Aster Vale clinic · 13:58, three hours and two minutes before dispersal launch*
The fog came through the sealed nursery wall without opening it. It entered as a pale blue seam, unfolded across the ceiling and pressed every hanging toy toward the floor at once.

Six-year-old Jo Pell coughed into an oxygen mask. Blue condensate had etched a white crescent into its rim. In the next bed, his brother Anik made no sound at all. The monitor above him showed eighty-four, then eighty-three.
Doctor Sen Var pulled the emergency curtain around both beds although the curtain could not stop weather.

**Sen**  
Pressure drop. Twelve millibars in eight seconds. Seal the bronchial circuit.
Technician Ro Kade struck the wall control. The room's vents closed. The fog thickened.
A chord moved through the glass cabinets—not heard so much as felt in teeth and ribs. Three notes rose, separated and rejoined. Frost drew branching lines over the medicine refrigerator.

Illuminara stepped between the beds and spread her light into a shallow golden canopy. Air stopped rushing from the boys' lungs, but the blue seam continued through her glow as rain through a beam from a window.

**Sen**  
Can you force it out?

**Illuminara**  
Yes. Not before I know what part of it is listening.

**Sen**  
One child is at eighty-three.

Illuminara lowered one hand. The air around Anik held at the pressure his damaged lungs could bear. With the other she touched the condensation on the cabinet. The droplets did not run down. They moved toward the warm print of her finger.
*Not an invasion toward bodies. A migration toward gradients.*
The doors opened. Governor Elian Voss entered with pilot Mara Kes and two sealed launch cases.

**Voss**  
The aircraft are fuelled. At seventeen hundred they seed calcium ash along the ridge. The fronts break, the incursions stop.
The chord in the cabinets dropped by half a tone. Blue mist curled around the warm oxygen tube beside Jo's cheek.

**Mara**  
That thing crossed three pressure walls. The seed gives it surfaces to condense on. We can pull it out of the valley.

**Illuminara**  
And if the front is a body?

**Mara**  
Then it entered a nursery in a body.
Jo lifted one hand from the blanket. His fingers trembled in the fog.

**Jo**  
It keeps saying warm.
Sen looked at him sharply.

**Sen**  
It is not speaking to you. Low oxygen makes patterns.

**Jo**  
Not a word. The same squeeze the storm made before it came through the wall.
Illuminara let the chord touch her canopy. A fourth pulse returned from every sealed room.

**Illuminara**  
Governor, give me ninety minutes before you load the ash.

**Voss**  
Ninety minutes. If clinic pressure falls again at fifteen-thirty, I decide.

**Sen**  
The boys do not become your experiment.

**Illuminara**  
No. The first room will be empty. And it will have doors on both sides.

scenes.title: The Argument About Outside
paragraphs: *North weather mast · 14:31, two hours and twenty-nine minutes before launch*
Beyond the mast, translucent fronts folded against the wind across half the northern sky.
Voss had ordered every family into the stone cistern halls. He remained at the mast because the launch code required his hand. Mara remained because the aircraft were hers.
Illuminara opened the mast's pressure valves one finger-width at a time. Each valve answered with a brass click. The folds in the sky tightened.

**Mara**  
They followed the heat leaks from the houses. We patched the leaks. They crossed the walls anyway.

**Illuminara**  
A wall makes the gradient steeper. To you it means keep out. To something that lives as moving pressure, it may mean a wound that must be equalised.

**Voss**  
Two children have chemical burns in their lungs. Do not ask me to admire the wound's philosophy.

**Illuminara**  
I am asking what will make it stop crossing.
She struck the lowest plate: compression, release, stillness. Three answering pulses drove rain upward from the fields.
Illuminara repeated the pattern, then left the final valve shut.
The response came harder. The mast groaned. A voice formed from the difference between windward and leeward glass.

**Visitors**  
You close continuation.
Mara's hand went to the launch case.

**Illuminara**  
We close inhabited air because your passage tears lungs.

**Visitors**  
There is no inhabited air. There is air. There is no outside from which permission arrives.

**Voss**  
Then there can be no agreement. Our children cannot live in your definition.
The front moved across the sun. Every anemometer on the mast spun backward.

**Visitors**  
Your still boxes remove the road. When a trailing front dries, its pressure sequence breaks; what it carried cannot rejoin us. Open all warm volumes until the sea-current rises.

**Mara**  
No.
She said it before Illuminara could answer.

**Mara**  
My daughter sleeps in one of those volumes. You crossed her room yesterday. She bled from both ears. We will not open the houses.
The front's lower edge whitened, a pressure response sharp enough to crack one pane of the mast.

**Visitors**  
One volume refuses the atmosphere? A cup orders the river not to wet it.

**Illuminara**  
A lung is not a cup. It exchanges and remains itself. It has a surface, and that surface is not an insult to the air.

**Visitors**  
Your surface cannot be perceived before collision.
There it was: not permission refused, but a boundary arriving too late to be meaningful.
Illuminara looked south toward the abandoned crop research station. Its old pressure farm had tested seeds under two atmospheres without exposing workers to either.

**Illuminara**  
If a boundary announced itself as a gradient you could feel before crossing, would you stop at it?

**Visitors**  
If stopping did not sever our rearward selves. If the path continued somewhere real.

**Voss**  
And if we make this path, do the incursions end?
The three notes separated in the mast.

**Visitors**  
Show a boundary that is not disappearance. Then we can choose.

**Mara**  
That was not a promise.

**Illuminara**  
No. It was a condition. Ours is that the houses remain closed and the clinic pressure never falls again.

**Voss**  
You have fifty-nine minutes before my decision returns.

scenes.title: A Room That Could Refuse
paragraphs: *Aster Vale pressure farm · 15:16, fourteen minutes before the clinic trigger*
A scratched glass cylinder held two halves divided by a flexible membrane. Each side had its own wheel; neither could open the other.

Ro worked beneath the controls. Sen held the south wheel because the chamber borrowed clinic warmth and only she could admit it. A nurse relayed the boys' monitors to her wrist. Mara brought warm water.

**Ro**  
The chamber can hold a six-millibar slope. More than that and the centre membrane walks out of its seals.

**Illuminara**  
We need four: one to warn, three to hold. First both halves stay at the same temperature. If the front stops, pressure can announce a boundary. Then we add warmth. If warmth pulls it through, the walls are more than walls.

**Sen**  
And what tells us they have not crossed?
Ro raised two tracer lamps, amber and blue.

**Ro**  
Amber marks us; blue marks them. If a sensor sees both, both wheels lock and the roof opens over the empty gravel field.
Voss set the armed case in sight. Its slurry loader was clipped to the farm's old thermal feed to keep the ash nozzles warm. The red countdown read 01:44:02.

**Voss**  
The clinic held. Your ninety minutes are almost gone. What exactly are you asking my people to risk?

**Illuminara**  
No person enters. Each side keeps a wheel. Ro has isolated the chamber valves from the old thermal feed. We test pressure alone, then warm amber; each result answers a different question.

**Sen**  
And if their pressure tears it?

**Illuminara**  
I hold the membrane long enough for the roof vents to clear the chamber. Not long enough to make the test succeed against either side's refusal.
Mara stared through the glass at the empty south half.

**Mara**  
You can hold a roof. You cannot promise a weather body will understand a lamp.

**Illuminara**  
No. That is why you keep your wheel.
Sen's wrist receiver chirped. She listened, then covered the speaker.

**Sen**  
Anik is at ninety-one on reduced oxygen. Jo is asking whether the weather knows his name. One failure, then I return. The boys do not fund a second attempt.

**Voss**  
Agreed.
The voice of the visitors came through the mast relay as a tremor in the chamber glass.

**Visitors**  
The road is too small. The smallest front may dry beyond rejoining; then the pressure memory that makes us one is lost.

**Illuminara**  
This is one question, not your road. You keep your wheel and may leave if continuity thins: can you feel a surface before collision and remain yourself while you stop?

**Visitors**  
You ask weather to become a guest in a jar.

**Mara**  
We ask you not to enter a child's lung.
A long pressure wave moved through the building. Dust rose from the floor in a perfect ring.

**Visitors**  
We will send the smallest front that still remembers us. We do not open your wheel.

**Sen**  
And we do not open yours.
Illuminara placed one palm against the centre seal. Not to command it. To be ready when tested.

**Illuminara**  
Then the first answer can be no on both sides. Begin.

scenes.title: The Test Front
paragraphs: *Aster Vale pressure farm · 16:04, fifty-six minutes before launch*
At 15:30 the clinic pressure had held. Voss's trigger passed without a fall; the launch clock kept running.

The north baffles sang first. A filament of blue fog entered the outer ring and stopped when it met the one-millibar warning slope. It spread sideways, tracing the chamber's circumference without touching the centre membrane.
The blue lamp brightened. The amber lamp remained alone.

**Ro**  
Boundary detected. No transfer.
Mara poured warmed water into the south evaporator. Amber vapour climbed the glass. The visitor filament pulled toward the heat and pressed the north wheel without turning it.

**Visitors**  
Continuation is present. The surface is early.
Sen did not take her hand off the south wheel.

**Sen**  
Stop there.
The filament stopped. For four seconds the chamber held two weathers separated by a membrane neither had crossed.
Then the pressure rose from below.
The floor plates bowed. The north filament flattened against the glass, not toward the amber vapour but toward a heating pipe beneath the seals. Ro looked at the gauge and swore.

**Ro**  
The launch loader pulled the farm loop across our isolation. Eleven degrees in nine seconds.
The centre membrane jumped two handspans south. Illuminara caught it with light and shoulder. The north sensor flashed amber and blue together.

**Sen**  
Contamination. Vent it.

Ro struck the roof release. Both chamber roofs opened. Blue and amber vapour rose into the empty gravel field. The visitor filament recoiled, then followed the warm exhaust upward rather than driving toward the occupied station.
Illuminara dimmed her own light until it no longer made another warm cliff.

**Illuminara**  
You chose the empty vent when the seal failed.

**Smallest Front**  
I remembered the breath that failed. I would not enter it again.
Mara shut her wheel. Sen had never opened hers.
The membrane sagged back into place. One lower seal had torn.

**Voss**  
The test failed.

**Illuminara**  
The chamber failed. The early boundary worked. The steep heat behind it pulled harder than the warning.

**Mara**  
Not sealed air. Waste heat.

**Illuminara**  
Pressure walls trap waste heat into cliffs. We built beacons and named them barriers.
The visitors answered from the gravel field, their voice weaker after the venting.

**Visitors**  
Warmth is the road. Your boxes cut it into cliffs. We cross before we perceive the surface.

**Voss**  
Can the aircraft move a road?
Mara turned toward the launch case. The red clock read 00:51:12.

**Mara**  
The aircraft can vent heated water instead of ash: a warm line from the northern folds to the sea current, over empty salt terraces. No roofs.

**Sen**  
For how long?

**Mara**  
Six hours. Tomorrow settlers can vote on a geothermal ridge duct from the north cooperative's exhaust stack, routed around two greenhouses.

**Visitors**  
Six hours is a gap, not continuation.

**Illuminara**  
Enough to test the corridor without crossing a home. Success earns a daylight vote; failure ends the duct.
The front darkened the windows.

**Visitors**  
Open the clinic volume as proof of trust.
Sen's answer struck the glass harder than the pressure chord.

**Sen**  
No.
Illuminara did not soften it.

**Illuminara**  
No. Trust is not paid with the bodies already harmed. You can refuse the corridor. You cannot purchase it with the children.
Voss closed the launch case and turned the key to hold. The red countdown went dark.

**Voss**  
Dispersal suspended until the corridor test ends. The ash will not decide your answer.
The three visitor notes separated. The highest faded first.

**Visitors**  
We refuse the clinic. We demand that the corridor's edge be announced in pressure before the warmth begins.

**Ro**  
We can pulse the aircraft vents twice before the release. Same early surface as the baffles.

**Mara**  
And I keep the ash aboard. If one front turns toward a roof, I disperse only that arm.

**Visitors**  
You retain a weapon.

**Mara**  
You retain a sky.
A small spiral of blue fog formed above the gravel, then loosened.

**Smallest Front**  
The warning reaches me before the warmth. I can refuse it and remain. Both retain refusal. Send the early surface.

**Visitors**  
We choose the corridor for six hours. The greater weather does not promise beyond it.

scenes.title: Weather with an Address
paragraphs: *Aster Vale salt terraces · 16:51–17:22, nine minutes before launch to twenty-two minutes after*
Mara's two aircraft banked over the empty salt terraces. They pulsed their vents twice, then released a warm ribbon toward the sea current. The first visitor front descended toward it.

At 16:51 the front reached the announced pressure edge. Its leading fold compressed, stopped and spread sideways along the invisible line. Mara watched the whole front turn west without touching a roof.
The northern folds followed one by one. At 16:56 Sen's voice broke over the aircraft channel.

**Sen**  
The last seam is leaving the clinic wall. Both boys are holding. No ash.
Rain travelled west in a narrow shining road that touched no roof. Above it, the visitors moved as separate fronts, no longer one wall across the sky.
Voss stood with twenty-three delegates. Ro's duct plan bent around the two greenhouses whose owners had voted no.

**Voss**  
The north cooperative offers one exhaust stack for thirty days. The clinic offers none. Every occupied building keeps its pressure wall. Renewal requires another vote.
The visitors spoke through three kites Ro had tethered at different heights. Their chords arrived with the rain.

**Visitors**  
Thirty days does not carry all rearward selves. We accept it for the delegation. The greater weather waits beyond the ridge.

**Mara**  
And the houses?

**Visitors**  
Closed volumes announce before warmth. We do not cross the announced surface. If a surface fails to announce, we call through the kites before following heat.
Sen arrived with Jo; Anik slept under observation at ninety-six oxygen.
Jo wore a paper mask decorated with two uneven blue spirals. He stopped well short of the first rain marker.

**Jo**  
Which one of you was in our room?
The lowest kite dipped.

**Smallest Front**  
I carried that crossing. I did not know your inside until your breath failed.

**Jo**  
Do you know now?

**Smallest Front**  
I know a lung is a weather that must not be entered whole.
Sen placed a hand on Jo's shoulder but did not ask him to forgive.

**Sen**  
Both boys will be examined for months. The clinic lost its nursery. Knowing comes after harm, not instead of it.

**Visitors**  
Then record the harm in the corridor call. Let every front hear before arrival.
Ro added a fourth pressure sequence to the kites: two children injured, one nursery closed, no unrestricted passage. The visitors repeated it without shortening it.
The farm's south greenhouse was lost to the loop failure. Its foundation became a proposed meeting chamber; no one called the ruin a gift.
Mara opened the launch case. The calcium ash canisters were still sealed.

**Mara**  
Store the ash in public. Any dispersal needs Sen, me and one elected delegate. No quiet launch.
The warm corridor began to cool as the aircraft turned home. The first geothermal vent opened on the northern stack, approved for thirty days. Rain shifted toward it, testing the new line.
The visitor delegation followed. At the marker above the clinic road, its smallest front paused, separated from the warmth and made the two warning pulses itself.
Jo raised one hand but did not step into the rain.
The blue spiral above him waited on its own side of the air.

critic_line: Illuminara, called to a valley where living weather fronts are crossing sealed homes and two boys are struggling to breathe, tests the visitors' fog against heat as well as language, and the failed chamber, an early pressure edge and a six-hour warm corridor turn the incursions away from every roof with the dispersal ash held back, at the price of a closed nursery, a lost greenhouse, months of examinations and a thirty-day route that cannot carry all the visitors' rearward selves.

literary_score.method: READER_APPEAL_R1; genuine independent GPT and Claude judgments; exact equal 50/50 arithmetic mean.
shared_strengths: Fresh premise (weather as delegation), humane stakes with sick children, dialogue-heavy, and a clean boundary-and-refusal resolution. But the technical procedure (millibars, wheels, membranes, timestamps) is dense and abstract, the dialogue is stiff, and the resolution is tidy and bureaucratic, which limits emotional pull.

The vivid weather-bodied visitors, urgent medical stakes, and dialogue-driven negotiation strongly match the audience. The solution emerges through experiment, mutual revision, and enforceable consent rather than easy harmony, while lasting injuries prevent sentimentality. The opening synopsis slightly blunts suspense, and some technical exposition may slow readers.
shared_reservations: Jo lifted one hand from the blanket. His fingers trembled in the fog. It keeps saying warm.
I know a lung is a weather that must not be entered whole.

translation_sl.title: OBISKOVALCI, KI SO PRIŠLI KOT VREME
translation_sl.deck: Delegacija, katere telesa so vremenski fronti, je prečkala zatesnjene domove Aster Vala, ker si ne zna predstavljati zunanjosti, dva otroka pa se zdaj borita za dih. Ker bodo letala za razpršitev vzletela čez tri ure, mora Illuminara odkriti mejo, ki jo obiskovalci lahko zaznajo in naseljenci nadzorujejo — ne da bi od katere koli strani zahtevala, naj vstopi v sobo, ki je ne more spustiti ven.
translation_sl.shape: Pet prizorov vodi od klinike, ki jo je preplavila živa megla, do prve izmenjave v tlaku in dežju ter nato do opuščene komore za poljščine, na novo zgrajene z dvema neodvisno krmiljenima membranama. Majhen poskus brez ljudi razkrije tekmovalni vzrok — vdore ne poganja le jezik, temveč toplota — in obe strani prisili, da spremenita zasnovo. Naseljenci in obiskovalci nazadnje izberejo zračen koridor, ki ustavi prehode, zaščiti otroke in ohrani stik, medtem ko poškodbe, uničen rastlinjak in zavrnjena zahteva obiskovalcev po neomejenem prehodu ostanejo resnični.

scenes.title: Vreme v otroški sobi
paragraphs: *Klinika Aster Vale · 13:58, tri ure in dve minuti pred vzletom za razpršitev*
Megla je prodrla skozi zatesnjeno steno otroške sobe, ne da bi jo odprla. Vstopila je kot bledomoder šiv, se razgrnila čez strop in vse viseče igrače hkrati potisnila proti tlom.

Šestletni Jo Pell je kašljal v kisikovo masko. Moder kondenz je v njen rob vrezal bel polmesec. V sosednji postelji njegov brat Anik ni izdal niti glasu. Monitor nad njim je pokazal štiriinosemdeset, nato triinosemdeset.
Zdravnica Sen Var je okoli obeh postelj potegnila zasilno zaveso, čeprav zavesa ni mogla ustaviti vremena.

**Sen**  
Padec tlaka. Dvanajst milibarov v osmih sekundah. Zatesnite bronhialni obtok.
Tehnik Ro Kade je udaril po stenskem krmilniku. Zračniki v prostoru so se zaprli. Megla se je zgostila.

Skozi steklene omarice je stekel akord — niso ga toliko slišali, kolikor so ga čutili v zobeh in rebrih. Trije toni so se dvignili, ločili in spet združili. Slana je čez hladilnik za zdravila risala razvejane črte.

Illuminara je stopila med postelji in svojo svetlobo razprla v plitek zlat baldahin. Zrak je prenehal uhajati iz pljuč dečkov, modri šiv pa je še naprej prehajal skozi njen sij kakor dež skozi snop svetlobe iz okna.

**Sen**  
Ga lahko izrineš?

**Illuminara**  
Da. Toda ne, dokler ne vem, kateri njegov del posluša.

**Sen**  
Eden od otrok je pri triinosemdesetih.

Illuminara je spustila eno roko. Zrak okoli Anika je obdržala pri tlaku, ki so ga njegova poškodovana pljuča še prenesla. Z drugo se je dotaknila kondenza na omarici. Kapljice niso stekle navzdol. Premaknile so se proti toplemu odtisu njenega prsta.
*Ne vdor proti telesom. Selitev proti gradientom.*
Vrata so se odprla. Guverner Elian Voss je vstopil s pilotko Maro Kes in dvema zatesnjenima zabojema za izstrelitev.

**Voss**  
Letala so napolnjena z gorivom. Ob sedemnajstih bodo vzdolž grebena zasejala kalcijev pepel. Fronti se razbijejo, vdori se končajo.
Akord v omaricah se je znižal za pol tona. Modra meglica se je ovila okoli tople kisikove cevke ob Jotovem licu.

**Mara**  
Ta stvar je prečkala tri tlačne stene. Seme ji bo dalo površine, na katerih se lahko kondenzira. Lahko jo izvlečemo iz doline.

**Illuminara**  
Kaj pa, če je front telo?

**Mara**  
Potem je kot telo vstopil v otroško sobo.
Jo je izpod odeje dvignil roko. Prsti so se mu tresli v megli.

**Jo**  
Ves čas govori toplo.
Sen ga je ostro pogledala.

**Sen**  
Ne govori s teboj. Zaradi premalo kisika vidiš vzorce.

**Jo**  
Ni beseda. Isti stisk kot v nevihti, preden je prišla skozi steno.
Illuminara je dovolila, da se je akord dotaknil njenega baldahina. Iz vsake zatesnjene sobe se je vrnil četrti sunek.

**Illuminara**  
Guverner, dajte mi devetdeset minut, preden naložite pepel.

**Voss**  
Devetdeset minut. Če tlak v kliniki ob petnajstih trideset spet pade, odločim jaz.

**Sen**  
Dečka ne bosta postala vaš poskus.

**Illuminara**  
Ne. Prva soba bo prazna. In imela bo vrata na obeh straneh.

scenes.title: Spor o zunanjosti
paragraphs: *Severni vremenski jambor · 14:31, dve uri in devetindvajset minut pred vzletom*
Za jamborom so se prosojni fronti v nasprotni smeri vetra zgibali čez polovico severnega neba.
Voss je ukazal, naj se vse družine umaknejo v kamnite dvorane cistern. Sam je ostal pri jamboru, ker je koda za vzlet zahtevala njegovo roko. Mara je ostala, ker so bila letala njena.
Illuminara je tlačne ventile jambora odpirala po širino enega prsta. Vsak ventil je odgovoril z medeninastim klikom. Gube na nebu so se napele.

**Mara**  
Sledili so uhajanju toplote iz hiš. Uhajanje smo zakrpali. Skozi stene so šli vseeno.

**Illuminara**  
Stena gradient naredi strmejši. Za vas pomeni ostani zunaj. Za nekaj, kar živi kot gibajoči se tlak, pa morda pomeni rano, ki jo je treba izenačiti.

**Voss**  
Dva otroka imata kemične opekline v pljučih. Ne zahtevajte, naj občudujem filozofijo te rane.

**Illuminara**  
Sprašujem, kaj bo doseglo, da bo prenehala prehajati.
Udarila je po najnižji plošči: stisk, sprostitev, mirovanje. Trije povratni sunki so z njiv pognali dež navzgor.
Illuminara je vzorec ponovila, zadnji ventil pa pustila zaprt.
Odgovor je prišel siloviteje. Jambor je zaječal. Iz razlike med privetrnim in zavetrnim steklom se je oblikoval glas.

**Obiskovalci**  
Zapirate nadaljevanje.
Marina roka je segla proti zaboju za izstrelitev.

**Illuminara**  
Zapiramo naseljeni zrak, ker vaš prehod trga pljuča.

**Obiskovalci**  
Naseljenega zraka ni. Je samo zrak. Ni zunanjosti, iz katere bi prišlo dovoljenje.

**Voss**  
Potem dogovor ni mogoč. Naši otroci ne morejo živeti v vaši opredelitvi.
Front je prešel čez sonce. Vsi vetromeri na jamboru so se zavrteli nazaj.

**Obiskovalci**  
Vaše mirujoče škatle odstranijo pot. Ko se zadnji front posuši, se njegovo tlačno zaporedje pretrga; kar je nosil, se nam ne more znova pridružiti. Odprite vse tople prostornine, dokler se morski tok ne dvigne.

**Mara**  
Ne.
To je rekla, še preden je Illuminara utegnila odgovoriti.

**Mara**  
Moja hči spi v eni od teh prostornin. Včeraj ste prečkali njeno sobo. Krvavela je iz obeh ušes. Hiš ne bomo odprli.
Spodnji rob fronta je pobelel; tlačni odziv je bil dovolj oster, da je počila ena od šip jambora.

**Obiskovalci**  
Ena prostornina zavrača ozračje? Skodelica ukazuje reki, naj je ne zmoči.

**Illuminara**  
Pljuča niso skodelica. Izmenjujejo in ostajajo svoja. Imajo površino in ta površina ni žalitev zraka.

**Obiskovalci**  
Vaše površine ni mogoče zaznati pred trkom.
To je bilo to: ne zavrnjeno dovoljenje, temveč meja, ki je prišla prepozno, da bi sploh kaj pomenila.

Illuminara je pogledala na jug proti zapuščeni postaji za raziskovanje poljščin. Njena stara tlačna farma je semena preskušala pod dvema atmosferama, ne da bi delavce izpostavila kateri koli od njiju.

**Illuminara**  
Če bi se meja napovedala kot gradient, ki bi ga lahko začutili pred prehodom, bi se pred njo ustavili?

**Obiskovalci**  
Če ustavitev ne bi odrezala naših zadnjih jazov. Če bi se pot nadaljevala nekam, kar je resnično.

**Voss**  
In če zgradimo to pot, se vdori končajo?
Trije toni so se v jamboru ločili.

**Obiskovalci**  
Pokažite mejo, ki ni izginotje. Potem lahko izberemo.

**Mara**  
To ni bila obljuba.

**Illuminara**  
Ne. Bil je pogoj. Naš je, da hiše ostanejo zaprte in tlak v kliniki nikoli več ne pade.

**Voss**  
Do vrnitve moje odločitve imate devetinpetdeset minut.

scenes.title: Soba, ki je lahko zavrnila
paragraphs: *Tlačna farma Aster Vale · 15:16, štirinajst minut pred sprožilcem v kliniki*
Opraskan steklen valj je držal dve polovici, ločeni s prožno membrano. Vsaka stran je imela svoje kolo; nobena ni mogla odpreti druge.

Ro je delal pod krmilniki. Sen je držala južno kolo, ker si je komora izposojala toploto klinike in jo je lahko spustila vanjo samo ona. Medicinska sestra je monitorja dečkov posredovala na njen zapestni sprejemnik. Mara je prinesla toplo vodo.

**Ro**  
Komora zdrži šestmilibarski naklon. Pri večjem se osrednja membrana izmakne iz tesnil.

**Illuminara**  
Potrebujemo štiri: enega za opozorilo, tri za zadržanje. Najprej obe polovici ostaneta pri isti temperaturi. Če se front ustavi, lahko tlak napove mejo. Potem dodamo toploto. Če ga toplota potegne skozi, so stene več kot samo stene.

**Sen**  
In kaj nam pove, da niso prečkali?
Ro je dvignil dve sledilni svetilki, jantarno in modro.

**Ro**  
Jantarna označuje nas, modra njih. Če tipalo zazna obe, se obe kolesi zakleneta in streha se odpre nad praznim gramoznim poljem.
Voss je oboroženi zaboj postavil na vidno mesto. Njegov nakladalnik za suspenzijo je bil priključen na stari toplotni vod farme, da so šobe za pepel ostale tople. Rdeče odštevanje je kazalo 01:44:02.

**Voss**  
Klinika je zdržala. Vaših devetdeset minut je skoraj mimo. Kaj natančno zahtevate od mojih ljudi, naj tvegajo?

**Illuminara**  
Nihče ne vstopi. Vsaka stran obdrži svoje kolo. Ro je ventile komore ločil od starega toplotnega voda. Najprej preizkusimo samo tlak, nato toplo jantarno meglico; vsak rezultat odgovori na drugo vprašanje.

**Sen**  
Kaj pa, če jo njihov tlak raztrga?

**Illuminara**  
Membrano držim dovolj dolgo, da strešni zračniki očistijo komoro. Ne dovolj dolgo, da bi poskus uspel proti zavrnitvi katere koli strani.
Mara je skozi steklo strmela v prazno južno polovico.

**Mara**  
Lahko držiš streho. Ne moreš obljubiti, da bo vremensko telo razumelo svetilko.

**Illuminara**  
Ne. Zato obdržite svoje kolo.
Senin zapestni sprejemnik je zacvrčal. Poslušala je, nato pokrila zvočnik.

**Sen**  
Anik je pri enaindevetdesetih z manj kisika. Jo sprašuje, ali vreme pozna njegovo ime. En neuspeh, potem se vrnem. Dečka ne bosta plačala drugega poskusa.

**Voss**  
Dogovorjeno.
Glas obiskovalcev je skozi rele jambora prišel kot tresljaj v steklu komore.

**Obiskovalci**  
Pot je premajhna. Najmanjši front se lahko posuši onkraj ponovne združitve; tedaj se izgubi tlačni spomin, zaradi katerega smo eno.

**Illuminara**  
To je eno vprašanje, ne vaša pot. Obdržite svoje kolo in lahko odidete, če se nadaljevanje stanjša: lahko začutite površino pred trkom in ostanete svoji, ko se ustavite?

**Obiskovalci**  
Od vremena zahtevate, naj postane gost v kozarcu.

**Mara**  
Prosimo vas, da ne vstopite v otrokova pljuča.
Dolg tlačni val je prešel skozi stavbo. Prah se je s tal dvignil v popolnem krogu.

**Obiskovalci**  
Poslali bomo najmanjši front, ki se nas še spominja. Vašega kolesa ne odpremo.

**Sen**  
In mi ne odpremo vašega.
Illuminara je eno dlan položila ob osrednje tesnilo. Ne zato, da bi mu ukazovala. Da bi bila pripravljena, ko bo preizkušeno.

**Illuminara**  
Potem je lahko prvi odgovor na obeh straneh ne. Začnimo.

scenes.title: Poskusni front
paragraphs: *Tlačna farma Aster Vale · 16:04, šestinpetdeset minut pred vzletom*
Ob 15:30 je tlak v kliniki zdržal. Vossov sprožilec je minil brez padca; ura do vzleta je tekla naprej.

Najprej so zapeli severni dušilniki. Nit modre megle je vstopila v zunanji obroč in se ustavila, ko je dosegla enomilibarski opozorilni naklon. Razširila se je vstran in zarisala obod komore, ne da bi se dotaknila osrednje membrane.
Modra svetilka je zasvetila močneje. Jantarna je ostala sama.

**Ro**  
Meja zaznana. Brez prehoda.
Mara je ogreto vodo zlila v južni uparjalnik. Jantarna para se je vzpela po steklu. Nit obiskovalcev je potegnilo proti toploti in pritisnila je na severno kolo, ne da bi ga obrnila.

**Obiskovalci**  
Nadaljevanje je prisotno. Površina pride zgodaj.
Sen ni umaknila roke z južnega kolesa.

**Sen**  
Ustavite se tam.
Nit se je ustavila. Komora je štiri sekunde držala dve vremeni, ločeni z membrano, ki je ni prečkalo nobeno.
Potem je tlak narasel od spodaj.
Talne plošče so se usločile. Severna nit se je sploščila ob steklu, vendar ne proti jantarni pari, temveč proti grelni cevi pod tesnili. Ro je pogledal merilnik in zaklel.

**Ro**  
Nakladalnik za izstrelitev je toplotni vod farme potegnil čez našo izolacijo. Enajst stopinj v devetih sekundah.
Osrednja membrana je odskočila za dve dlani proti jugu. Illuminara jo je ujela s svetlobo in ramo. Severno tipalo je hkrati utripalo jantarno in modro.

**Sen**  
Kontaminacija. Prezračite.

Ro je sprožil odpiranje strehe. Obe strehi komore sta se odprli. Modra in jantarna para sta se dvignili v prazno gramozno polje. Nit obiskovalcev se je zdrznila, nato pa sledila toplemu izpuhu navzgor, namesto da bi se pognala proti naseljeni postaji.
Illuminara je zatemnila svojo svetlobo, dokler ni več ustvarjala novega toplega klifa.

**Illuminara**  
Ko je tesnilo popustilo, ste izbrali prazni zračnik.

**Najmanjši front**  
Spomnil sem se diha, ki je odpovedal. Vanj nisem hotel znova vstopiti.
Mara je zaprla svoje kolo. Sen svojega ni nikoli odprla.
Membrana se je povesila nazaj na mesto. Eno spodnje tesnilo se je raztrgalo.

**Voss**  
Poskus ni uspel.

**Illuminara**  
Komora ni uspela. Zgodnja meja je delovala. Strma toplota za njo je vlekla močneje od opozorila.

**Mara**  
Ne zatesnjeni zrak. Odpadna toplota.

**Illuminara**  
Tlačne stene odpadno toploto ujamejo v klife. Zgradili smo svetilnike in jih imenovali ovire.
Obiskovalci so odgovorili z gramoznega polja; po prezračevanju je bil njihov glas šibkejši.

**Obiskovalci**  
Toplota je pot. Vaše škatle jo režejo v klife. Prečkamo, preden zaznamo površino.

**Voss**  
Lahko letala premaknejo pot?
Mara se je obrnila proti zaboju za izstrelitev. Rdeča ura je kazala 00:51:12.

**Mara**  
Letala lahko namesto pepela odvajajo ogreto vodo: toplo črto od severnih gub do morskega toka, nad praznimi solnimi terasami. Brez streh.

**Sen**  
Kako dolgo?

**Mara**  
Šest ur. Jutri lahko naseljenci glasujejo o geotermalnem vodu po grebenu iz izpušnega dimnika severne zadruge, speljanem okoli dveh rastlinjakov.

**Obiskovalci**  
Šest ur je vrzel, ne nadaljevanje.

**Illuminara**  
Dovolj, da koridor preizkusimo brez prečkanja doma. Uspeh prinese glasovanje pri dnevni svetlobi; neuspeh konča vod.
Front je zatemnil okna.

**Obiskovalci**  
Odprite prostornino klinike kot dokaz zaupanja.
Senin odgovor je udaril po steklu močneje kot tlačni akord.

**Sen**  
Ne.
Illuminara odgovora ni omehčala.

**Illuminara**  
Ne. Zaupanja ne plačujemo s telesi že poškodovanih. Koridor lahko zavrnete. Ne morete ga kupiti z otroki.
Voss je zaprl zaboj za izstrelitev in ključ obrnil na zadržanje. Rdeče odštevanje je ugasnilo.

**Voss**  
Razpršitev je prekinjena do konca preskusa koridorja. Pepel ne bo odločil namesto vas.
Trije toni obiskovalcev so se ločili. Najvišji je prvi zbledel.

**Obiskovalci**  
Kliniko zavračamo. Zahtevamo, da je rob koridorja s tlakom napovedan, preden se začne toplota.

**Ro**  
Zračnike letal lahko pred izpustom dvakrat sunkovito odpremo. Enaka zgodnja površina kot pri dušilnikih.

**Mara**  
Pepel pa ostane na krovu. Če se kateri od frontov obrne proti strehi, razpršim samo tisti krak.

**Obiskovalci**  
Obdržite orožje.

**Mara**  
Vi obdržite nebo.
Nad gramozom se je oblikovala majhna spirala modre megle, nato se je razrahljala.

**Najmanjši front**  
Opozorilo me doseže pred toploto. Lahko ga zavrnem in ostanem. Obe strani obdržita možnost zavrnitve. Pošljite zgodnjo površino.

**Obiskovalci**  
Koridor izberemo za šest ur. Večje vreme ne obljublja ničesar po tem.

scenes.title: Vreme z naslovom
paragraphs: *Solne terase Aster Vale · 16:51–17:22, od devetih minut pred vzletom do dvaindvajset minut po njem*
Marini letali sta zavili nad praznimi solnimi terasami. Dvakrat sta sunkovito odprli zračnike, nato proti morskemu toku izpustili topel trak. Prvi front obiskovalcev se je spustil proti njemu.

Ob 16:51 je front dosegel napovedani tlačni rob. Njegova vodilna guba se je stisnila, ustavila in razširila vstran vzdolž nevidne črte. Mara je gledala, kako se je ves front obrnil proti zahodu, ne da bi se dotaknil ene same strehe.
Severne gube so mu sledile ena za drugo. Ob 16:56 se je po letalskem kanalu prelomil Senin glas.

**Sen**  
Zadnji šiv zapušča steno klinike. Oba dečka sta stabilna. Brez pepela.
Dež je potoval proti zahodu po ozki bleščeči poti, ki se ni dotaknila nobene strehe. Nad njo so se obiskovalci premikali kot ločeni fronti, nič več kot en sam zid čez nebo.
Voss je stal s triindvajsetimi delegati. Rojev načrt voda je zavil okoli rastlinjakov dveh lastnikov, ki sta glasovala proti.

**Voss**  
Severna zadruga za trideset dni ponuja en izpušni dimnik. Klinika ne ponuja nobenega. Vsaka naseljena stavba obdrži svojo tlačno steno. Za podaljšanje je potrebno novo glasovanje.
Obiskovalci so govorili skozi tri zmaje, ki jih je Ro privezal na različnih višinah. Njihovi akordi so prišli z dežjem.

**Obiskovalci**  
Trideset dni ne ponese vseh zadnjih jazov. Za delegacijo jih sprejemamo. Večje vreme čaka onkraj grebena.

**Mara**  
Kaj pa hiše?

**Obiskovalci**  
Zaprte prostornine se napovejo pred toploto. Napovedane površine ne prečkamo. Če se površina ne napove, pred sledenjem toploti pokličemo skozi zmaje.
Sen je prišla z Jojem; Anik je spal na opazovanju pri šestindevetdesetih odstotkih kisika.
Jo je nosil papirnato masko, okrašeno z dvema neenakima modrima spiraloma. Ustavil se je precej pred prvo dežno oznako.

**Jo**  
Kateri od vas je bil v naši sobi?
Najnižji zmaj se je spustil.

**Najmanjši front**  
Jaz sem nosil tisti prehod. Nisem poznal vaše notranjosti, dokler ni odpovedal vaš dih.

**Jo**  
Ali zdaj veš?

**Najmanjši front**  
Vem, da so pljuča vreme, v katero ne smemo vstopiti v celoti.
Sen je položila roko na Jotovo ramo, vendar ga ni prosila za odpuščanje.

**Sen**  
Oba dečka bodo pregledovali še več mesecev. Klinika je izgubila otroško sobo. Spoznanje pride po škodi, ne namesto nje.

**Obiskovalci**  
Potem škodo zapišite v klic koridorja. Naj jo vsak front sliši pred prihodom.
Ro je zmajem dodal četrto tlačno zaporedje: dva poškodovana otroka, ena zaprta otroška soba, brez neomejenega prehoda. Obiskovalci so ga ponovili, ne da bi ga skrajšali.
Južni rastlinjak farme je bil izgubljen zaradi odpovedi voda. Njegovi temelji so postali predlagana sejna soba; nihče ruševine ni imenoval darilo.
Mara je odprla zaboj za izstrelitev. Posode s kalcijevim pepelom so bile še vedno zatesnjene.

**Mara**  
Pepel shranite javno. Za vsako razpršitev smo potrebni Sen, jaz in en izvoljeni delegat. Nobenega tihega vzleta.

Topli koridor se je začel ohlajati, ko sta letali zavili domov. Na severnem dimniku se je odprl prvi geotermalni zračnik, odobren za trideset dni. Dež se je premaknil proti njemu in preskušal novo črto.
Delegacija obiskovalcev mu je sledila. Pri oznaki nad cesto h kliniki se je njen najmanjši front ustavil, ločil od toplote in sam sprožil dva opozorilna sunka.
Jo je dvignil eno roko, vendar ni stopil v dež.
Modra spirala nad njim je počakala na svoji strani zraka.

translation_sl.critic_line: Illuminara, poklicana v dolino, kjer živi vremenski fronti prečkajo zatesnjene domove in se dva dečka borita za dih, meglo obiskovalcev preizkusi tako s toploto kakor z jezikom; spodletela komora, zgodnji tlačni rob in šesturni topli koridor nato vdore preusmerijo stran od vseh streh, pepel za razpršitev pa ostane zadržan — za ceno zaprte otroške sobe, izgubljenega rastlinjaka, večmesečnih pregledov in tridesetdnevne poti, ki ne more ponesti vseh zadnjih jazov obiskovalcev.
